title: Pure Yokai Girl
summary: Pure Yokai Girl (Ghost Girl) handtrap and Zombie Synchro deck, turning the six iconic Level 3 0 ATK / 1800 DEF Tuner maidens into an active combat strategy. Discarded as handtraps on turn 0, they become instant fuel for Mezuki, Gozuki, and Zombie Synchro revivals.

summary.title: Starters
points: Piri Reis Map adds any 0 ATK monster (any of the six Yokai Girls or Red Blossoms from Underroot) from your Deck to your hand at the start of Main Phase 1.
Emergency Teleport Special Summons Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit directly from your hand or Deck, where she can either fire her Quick Effect destruction from the field or serve as a Level 3 Tuner.
Uni-Zombie sends Mezuki or Gozuki from your Deck to the GY, adjusts monster Levels by 1 or 2, and pairs with revived Level 3 Yokai Girls for Synchro Summons.
Gozuki sends Mezuki from Deck to GY on summon, and banishes a Zombie from GY to Special Summon a Zombie from hand.
Mezuki banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon any Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner directly from your GY.
Foolish Burial sends Mezuki or Gozuki to GY, and Monster Reborn revives any Tuner or Synchro Monster.

summary.title: Opening: Handtrap Disruption into Uni-Zombie
steps: Interrupt the opponent's turn by discarding Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring (or Ghost Mourner / Ghost Belle), sending a Level 3 Zombie Tuner to your GY.

On your turn, Normal Summon Uni-Zombie; activate its first effect to send Mezuki from your hand or field to GY (or activate its second effect to send Mezuki from Deck to GY, raising Uni-Zombie's Level to 4).
Banish Mezuki from your GY to Special Summon the discarded Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring from your GY.
Synchro Summon Level 7 Black Rose Dragon (using Level 4 Uni-Zombie + Level 3 Ash Blossom) to wipe the entire field, or Level 8 Skeletal Dragon Felgrand (if modulated to Level 5).
Link Summon Vampire Sucker using any two Zombie monsters, drawing 1 card whenever Mezuki revives another Yokai Girl.

summary.title: The Six Ghost Maidens
points: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring negates effects that add cards from Deck to hand, Special Summon from Deck, or send cards from Deck to GY.
Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit sends itself from hand or field to GY to destroy a face-up monster or Spell/Trap on the field that activated its effect.
Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion negates activations that add cards from GY, Special Summon from GY, or banish cards from GY.
Ghost Mourner & Moonlit Chill negates the effects of an opponent's Special Summoned monster and burns for its original ATK if it leaves the field.
Ghost Sister & Spooky Dogwood gains LP equal to the ATK of every Effect Monster the opponent Special Summons that turn.
Ghost Reaper & Winter Cherries reveals an Extra Deck monster to banish all copies of that card from the opponent's Extra Deck.
Red Blossoms from Underroot Special Summons itself while both players have cards in GY and banishes Spells/Traps or Extra Deck monsters from GY to revive monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Skeletal Dragon Felgrand banishes an opponent monster from field or GY upon Special Summon, and negates a face-up monster's effects whenever a monster is Special Summoned from either GY.

Red-Eyes Zombie Dragon Lord is a Level 10 Synchro that revives a Zombie monster (such as Felgrand or a Yokai Girl) from your GY as a Quick Effect during the opponent's turn, and revives itself by banishing a Zombie you control.
Immortal Dragon sends a Zombie monster from Deck to GY to modulate its Level and climbs into higher Synchros.
Black Rose Dragon obliterates all cards on the field upon Synchro Summon.
Vampire Sucker draws 1 card every time a Zombie monster is Special Summoned from either GY, rewarding continuous Mezuki loops.

main: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring

Level 3 FIRE Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner (0 ATK / 1800 DEF): discards itself as a Quick Effect to negate any effect that adds a card from the Deck to the hand, Special Summons from the Deck, or sends a card from the Deck to the GY; then revives from your GY via Mezuki as a Level 3 Zombie Tuner!
Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit

Level 3 LIGHT Psychic Yokai Girl Tuner (0 ATK / 1800 DEF; summonable from Deck by Emergency Teleport!): when a monster on the field or a face-up Spell/Trap activates its effect (Quick Effect), sends itself from your hand OR FIELD to the GY to destroy that card on the field!
Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion

Level 3 EARTH Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner (0 ATK / 1800 DEF): discards itself as a Quick Effect to negate the activation of any card or effect that adds a card from the GY, Special Summons from the GY, or banishes a card from the GY!
Ghost Mourner & Moonlit Chill

Level 3 WIND Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner (0 ATK / 1800 DEF): discards itself when your opponent Special Summons a face-up monster(s) to negate its effects this turn and inflict burn damage equal to its original ATK if it leaves the field!
Ghost Sister & Spooky Dogwood

Level 3 WATER Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner (0 ATK / 1800 DEF): discards itself during either turn to gain LP equal to the ATK of every Effect Monster your opponent Special Summons during the Main Phase or Battle Phase this turn!
Ghost Reaper & Winter Cherries

Level 3 DARK Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner (0 ATK / 1800 DEF): if your opponent controls more monsters than you do (Quick Effect), discards itself and reveals 1 Extra Deck monster to banish all copies of that card from your opponent's Extra Deck!
Red Blossoms from Underroot

Level 1 DARK Fiend companion (0 ATK / 1800 DEF; searchable by Piri Reis Map!): if both players have a card(s) in their GYs, Special Summons itself from your hand; then banishes 1 Spell/Trap from either GY to revive 1 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster from your GY, or banishes an Extra Deck monster from GY to revive a Level 4 or lower monster!
Uni-Zombie

Core Level 3 DARK Zombie starter: sends Mezuki or Gozuki from your Deck to the GY and increases a monster's Level by 1 or 2 so your revived Level 3 Yokai Girl Tuners can make Level 7, 8, and 10 Synchros!
Gozuki

Level 4 EARTH Zombie non-Tuner: sends Mezuki from your Deck to the GY once per turn, and tunes with any revived Level 3 Yokai Girl Tuner into Level 7 Black Rose Dragon (or Level 8 Skeletal Dragon Felgrand after Uni-Zombie +1 Level!).
Mezuki
Level 4 EARTH Zombie non-Tuner: banishes itself from your GY to Special Summon any of the 5 Zombie-Type Yokai Girl Tuners from your GY after they resolve as handtraps!
Emergency Teleport
Special Summons Level 3 Psychic Tuner 'Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit' directly from your hand or Deck—where she can either fire her Quick Effect destruction from the field OR tune into a Synchro Monster!
Piri Reis Map
Searches any 0 ATK Yokai Girl or Red Blossoms from Underroot from your Deck at the start of Main Phase 1.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Mezuki from your Deck to the GY to revive a discarded Yokai Girl Tuner.
Monster Reborn
Limited to 1 in TCG: revives any Yokai Girl Tuner or Synchro Monster from either GY.
extra: Level 8 LIGHT Zombie Synchro boss (1 Zombie Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters: any Zombie Yokai Girl Tuner + Level 5-modulated Gozuki/Mezuki): banishes 1 monster your opponent controls or in their GY on Special Summon, and negates the effects of 1 face-up monster whenever a monster is Special Summoned from either GY!

Level 10 DARK Zombie Synchro boss (1 Zombie Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners): during your opponent's turn (Quick Effect), Special Summons 1 Zombie monster (Skeletal Dragon Felgrand or a Yokai Girl Tuner!) from your GY; and banishes a Zombie you control to revive itself from your GY!

Level 6 DARK Zombie Synchro Tuner (Level 3 Yokai Girl Tuner + Level 3 Uni-Zombie): sends Mezuki or Gozuki from your Deck to the GY to adjust its Level and climb into Level 8 Felgrand or Level 10 Red-Eyes Zombie Dragon Lord!
Level 7 FIRE Dragon Synchro (any revived Level 3 Yokai Girl Tuner + Level 4 Gozuki/Mezuki = 7) that destroys all cards on the field on Synchro Summon!

Link-2 DARK Zombie (2 Zombie monsters: made with any two Zombie Yokai Girls!) that revives a monster to the opponent's field as a Zombie and draws 1 card every time a Zombie Yokai Girl is revived from your GY!
